description: This file defines the UserProfileItem interface, which specifies methods related to user profile settings for ECU logging within the RomRaider project.

classes.name: UserProfileItem
classes.description: An interface that declares methods for accessing user profile preferences related to ECU data logging in RomRaider.

methods.name: isDashSelected
methods.description: Returns whether the dashboard display is selected in the user profile.

methods.name: isGraphSelected
methods.description: Returns whether the graph display is selected in the user profile.

methods.name: isLiveDataSelected
methods.description: Returns whether live data streaming is selected in the user profile.

methods.name: getUnits
methods.description: Returns the units of measurement used in the user profile.
